build_suggest_policy_templates: build policy template suggestions from attack examples and descriptions using LLM tool calling
create_AiPolicySuggester_suggest: create an AiPolicySuggester instance and call suggest with templates, attack examples, and a description
build_system_prompt: build a system prompt that lists available policy templates with IDs, titles, descriptions, and example attacks
build_user_prompt: build a user prompt from attack examples and a description of what to block
test_suggest: test the AiPolicySuggester.suggest method with sample templates and attack examples
